title: Thu 29 Oct · Full body
notes: First one in Hevy. Pick weights you could do 2–3 more reps with; I'll set them from here next time. Three pairs: do A1 then A2, rest, repeat. Legs stay moderate: if your back or legs tighten, skip the rest of that exercise.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.note: A1. Moderate. Heels down, chest up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.note: A2. One arm, other hand and knee on the bench so your back is supported.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: B1. Flat bench. Elbows about 45° from your sides, not flared.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.note: B2. Bodyweight. Squeeze at the top for a second.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: C1. Seated, bench upright. Palms facing each other (neutral grip), easier on the left shoulder.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.note: Finisher, on its own. Slow. Low back stays flat on the floor.
